set.body: Deliver a source-grounded implementation plan for cancellable execution, scientific serialization, and typed method/preflight APIs. Register granular unassigned tickets with scoped paths, concrete dependencies, proposed tests and exit criteria; reuse existing Mote owners. Publish docs/UI_FOUNDATION_PLAN.md and its development-plan link, verify the resulting graph, then close only this planning task. No scientific implementation or GUI work is part of this task.
set.title: Plan and register eyes4s infrastructure for the UI consumer
